prompt:
Vertical 9:16, photorealistic travel portrait taken at a window seat of a daytime train. An imaginary adult Japanese woman, appearing to be 24-30 years old. Close-up half-body shot from the top of the head to below the chest. Position the person slightly to the left of the center, with the body facing more to the right than the front. Face directed toward the window in the upper right, not looking at the camera. Lightly place the base of the right index finger under the right side of the chin, thumb under the chin, and other fingers naturally curved. A modest smile of anticipation with teeth slightly visible, as if imagining the destination outside the window.
Long dark brown hair nearly black. Side part on the left, face-framing hair following the cheeks without being tucked behind ears, and ends curled inward at the chest. Dark brown eyes with vertical window catchlights, thin brown eyeliner, light coral beige makeup, and natural rose lips. Skin in bright natural light, retaining textures of pores, fine hairs, and lips.
Costume consists of a light gray thin ribbed tank top under an ivory thin cardigan. The cardigan is open, showing small round matching buttons and natural fabric folds. Exposure is elegant and everyday. The background shows part of the train window frame and blue seats, while the outside view is a flowing blur of cityscapes in pale blue, white, and beige. Soft window light from the front right, weak warm interior reflections on the left.
85mm equivalent, f/2.0, eye-level height with the seated person. Precise focus on the near eye, eyelashes, and fingertips; background and far hair are smoothly blurred. No text, route names, logos, ads, readable signs, extra fingers, fingers stabbing the chin, distorted windows, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin smoothing, strong HDR, or CG feel.

promptZh:
竖屏 9:16，在日间火车靠窗座位拍摄的写实旅行肖像。一位虚构的成年日本女性，年龄设定为 24-30 岁。从头顶到胸部以下的半身特写镜头。人物位于画面中心偏左，身体朝向右侧多于正前方。面部朝向右上方的窗户，不看镜头。右手食指根部轻抵下巴右侧，拇指托住下巴，其余手指自然弯曲。表情为 带着期待的矜持微笑，微露牙齿，仿佛正在想象窗外的目的地。
深棕色长发近乎黑色。左侧分缝，修饰脸型的发丝顺着脸颊垂下，未别在耳后，发梢在胸前向内卷曲。深棕色眼眸中带有竖向的窗户反光，细棕色眼线，浅珊瑚米色妆容，自然的玫瑰色嘴唇。皮肤处于明亮的自然光下，保留了毛孔、细小绒毛和唇纹的质感。
服装为 象牙色薄开衫内搭浅灰色细罗纹背心。开衫敞开，露出小巧的同色系圆扣和自然的衣褶。曝光优雅且具有生活气息。背景可见部分火车窗框和蓝色座椅，窗外是淡蓝色、白色和米色交织的流动城市景观。柔和的窗光从右前方射入，左侧有微弱的室内暖光反射。
85mm 等效焦距，f/2.0 光圈，与坐姿人物平视。焦点精准对准近处的眼睛、睫毛和指尖；背景和远处的头发呈现平滑的虚化效果。无文字、路线名称、Logo、广告、可辨识的标志、多余的手指、手指戳入下巴、扭曲的窗户、不对称的眼睛、过度磨皮、强烈的 HDR 或 CG 感。
